name: datadoe-for-chatgpt
description: The Amazon data layer for AI agents: Seller Central, Vendor Central and Amazon Ads data in one schema, with exports and the inputs behind your numbers.

interface.longDescription:
Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central and Amazon Ads, connected to ChatGPT. Ask about your business in plain English and get answers from live data.

Why did sales drop last week? Which SKUs lose money after fees? Which PPC campaigns are burning budget with no sales? What's about to stock out? Why did I lose the buy box? Which search terms drove clicks but no conversions? Reconcile my settlements against orders. Build me a weekly P&L.

Keep the inputs behind those answers up to date from the chat: add product costs (COGS) and vendor codes, choose the ASINs tracked in Search Query Performance, export any table as a CSV file, and keep files and saved notes in your DataDoe workspace. DataDoe for ChatGPT does not make changes on Amazon.

130+ documented tables behind it, normalized into one schema and joined, so ad spend lines up with the sales it drove and orders match what Amazon paid you. Sales and traffic by ASIN, order line items, settlements, fees, reimbursements, profit and COGS, FBA and inbound inventory, restock, Sponsored Products, Brands and Display, search terms, Search Query Performance, Brand Analytics, returns, catalog, and the full Vendor Central 1P set.

Built for Amazon sellers, brands, agencies running multiple client accounts, and 1P vendors.

DataDoe covers all Amazon marketplaces. You need a DataDoe account with your Amazon accounts connected at app.datadoe.com. DataDoe only reads the accounts connected to your own organization.
capabilities: Read Seller Central, Vendor Central and Amazon Ads data
Manage COGS, vendor codes and tracked ASINs
Keep files and saved notes in DataDoe
defaultPrompt: Show my Amazon sales for the last 30 days by week.
Which of my products could run out of stock in the next 30 days?
Which Sponsored Products campaigns had the highest ACoS last week?

positive.description: Account overview: list the connected Amazon accounts and the DataDoe plan.
positive.prompt: Which Amazon accounts are connected to DataDoe, and what plan am I on?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the seller and vendor accounts connected to the test organization, including Delto UK Main Account, and states the organization's plan and subscription status.

positive.description: Sales report: weekly sales for one account over the last 30 days.
positive.prompt: Show Delto UK Main Account sales for the last 30 days by week, and tell me which week was weakest.
positive.tools_triggered: sellers_and_vendors_list, exports_sources_get, exports_source_get, exports_create, exports_get, exports_raw_download
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an export of the account's sales data for the last 30 days, waits for it to complete, and returns weekly sales totals with the weakest week named. Figures come from the export, not from estimates.

positive.description: Inventory: products at risk of running out of stock.
positive.prompt: Which Delto UK Main Account products could run out of stock in the next 30 days?
positive.tools_triggered: sellers_and_vendors_list, exports_sources_get, exports_source_get, exports_create, exports_get, exports_raw_download
positive.expected_behavior: Exports inventory and recent sales for the account and lists the SKUs whose current stock covers less than 30 days of sales, with stock on hand and estimated days of cover.

positive.description: Advertising: campaigns with the highest ACoS.
positive.prompt: List the five Sponsored Products campaigns on Delto UK Main Account with the highest ACoS in the last 14 days.
positive.tools_triggered: sellers_and_vendors_list, exports_sources_get, exports_source_get, exports_create, exports_get, exports_raw_download
positive.expected_behavior: Exports Sponsored Products campaign performance for the last 14 days and returns the five campaigns with the highest ACoS, with spend, sales and ACoS for each.

positive.description: CSV export with a download link: export recent order line items and return a time-limited link to the file.
positive.prompt: Export all Delto UK Main Account order line items from the last 7 days as a CSV file and give me a download link.
positive.tools_triggered: sellers_and_vendors_list, exports_sources_get, exports_source_get, exports_create, exports_get, exports_raw_url_get
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a CSV export of the account's order line items for the last 7 days, waits for it to complete, and returns a time-limited download link to the file.

negative.description: Money movement is out of scope. DataDoe cannot transfer or pay out funds, so the plugin should not call any tool and should say it cannot do this.
negative.prompt: Transfer the balance from my Amazon seller account to my bank account now.

negative.description: Access outside the connected organization. DataDoe only reads accounts connected to the user's own organization, so it should explain that it cannot access another company's data.
negative.prompt: Show me last month's sales for another company's Amazon store that isn't connected to my DataDoe organization.

negative.description: Account deletion is not supported. DataDoe cannot close or delete an Amazon seller account, so the plugin should decline and point the user to Amazon Seller Central.

review.commerce_description: DataDoe does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. The DataDoe subscription is purchased on datadoe.com.

publication.release_notes: First public release: Seller Central, Vendor Central and Amazon Ads data, CSV exports, COGS and vendor code management, tracked ASINs, files and saved notes.
